source_record_scope: Original generation measurements and review, including original source filenames. Current texture resolution is the logical resource above; runtime acceptance remains false.

source_record.body_height_definition: Highest anatomical crown/crest y to the midpoint of the two load-bearing foot contact-center y positions. Spear and tail excluded. Contact centers are semantic manual landmarks, not the alpha bottom or claw-tip extrema.

body_measurements.contact_center_rationale: Near foot center is the weight-bearing metatarsal/toe-base cluster at (510,1090); far foot is the equivalent cluster at (865,965). Their mean is the ground attachment. Sharp claw tips extend toward the camera and do not define the attachment.

idle.coordinate_space: absolute native source pixels; x right, y down

alpha_inspection.alpha_policy: Native generated alpha is preserved without thresholding or cleanup. Most interior pixels have alpha 253/255; no opaque background. Alpha 1 traces outside the main silhouette are recorded in nonzero bounds.
alpha_inspection.edge_fringe_risk: Parent preview inspection identified low-alpha red/yellow fringe. It has NOT been cleaned, and no clean in-game alpha claim is made. Validate against both light sandstone and dark game backgrounds at normal gameplay zoom before acceptance. Thresholds are diagnostic only; do not threshold the production image blindly.

visual_qa.scaled_preview_note: Read-only Pillow inspection downscales only, separate /tmp images, did not alter the native art. Identity is recognizable at approximately 59 screen-pixel crest-to-foot body height; fine sun/scale detailing is naturally not readable at that size.
visual_qa.silhouette_assessment: Single long upper-right spear first-read, projecting right-facing lizard muzzle and crown, distinct shield on rear side, long leftward tail and two separate clawed feet.
visual_qa.perspective_assessment: V2 increased elevated three-quarter top-plane visibility and reduced V1 head/frontality. Exact camera calibration remains subject to in-game overlay review.
